name: Pluto
fact: Pluto and its moon Charon co-orbit a barycenter outside Pluto's surface — the only true binary system among the major bodies. New Horizons flew past in July 2015, revealing the heart-shaped Tombaugh Regio and water-ice mountains.
bio: Demoted from planet status by the IAU in 2006 — the same year New Horizons launched toward it. The flyby returned more data on Pluto than humanity had collected in the prior 76 years since Tombaugh's discovery photographs.

links.l: Why Pluto is no longer a planet (IAU 2006 resolution)

science_sections.why: Pluto's 0.249 eccentricity is so high its orbit dips inside Neptune's for 20 years per 248-year cycle (1979–1999 was the last such interval).
Pluto's 17.2° orbital inclination is the highest of any commonly-recognised planet or dwarf planet — well above the ecliptic where the gas giants live.
Perihelion 29.7 AU vs aphelion 49.3 AU — a 20 AU swing means surface temperatures vary enough for Pluto’s atmosphere to thicken near perihelion and freeze out near aphelion.
Pluto and Charon are tidally locked to each other — both rotation periods equal the 6.4-day mutual orbital period. The pair is treated as a true binary in much modern literature.
Pluto is the largest member of the Kuiper Belt — its discovery in 1930 predated the belt concept by 60 years.
